_why: The critic can only judge us against a shot taken from a camera we actually have.
Most of this set is promo material: character renders with cinematic depth of
field, and strategy-layer menus. Comparing our tactical overview against those
sets a bar no overview camera can clear, and the resulting notes are noise.
tools/blind.mjs reads this file and refuses a cross-category pairing.

categories.tactical: Overview mission camera — what src/input and the shot harness produce by default. Compare our standard screenshots against these.
categories.shotcam: Over-the-shoulder targeting view with the firing HUD. Compare shot-cam captures (tools/shotcam.mjs) against these.
categories.character: Cinematic/promo close-ups. No tactical HUD, heavy DoF, hand-placed lighting. Useful for material and armour detail only — never for framing, scale or scene composition.
categories.ui: Strategy layer and menu screens. No 3D scene to compare against; kept for HUD typography and panel styling reference.
